context:
Goal: reviewed PRs merge, and planned work starts again once the queue drains.
Problem (rule): your hold on new lanes names no end, so planned steps wait with nothing that restarts them.
Based on (notes): 400 or more PRs are open, and one batch took 27 lanes in 43 h (coordinator, 10:11 CST Nov 8; no tool has counted it).
Based on (ruling): record lane-inflow-hold (PR #1768) says "Ends: the ruling names no end"; on item 384 you picked none of its limits (50 or 20 reviewed PRs) and held with no limit.
Departs from: main, where the coordinator starts every ready step at once (rule parallelism-keep-going) — new lanes wait until the end you set here.
Meanwhile: the hold stands; only your asks and gap fixes start lanes (items 387 a and 410 a).

options.gain: Planned work restarts by itself once half the queue has merged.
options.how: The coordinator lifts the hold on its own once fewer than 200 PRs are open, and the record says so.
options.label: End it when open PRs fall under 200
options.lose: Planned steps keep waiting until then, for a time nobody has measured.

options.how: The coordinator starts every ready step again now.
options.label: Lift it now
options.lose: More lanes finish into a queue of 400 PRs that batches already merge slower than lanes fill it.

options.gain: No new lane adds to the queue.
options.how: The hold stays until you lift it in your own words.
options.label: Keep it, with no end
options.lose: Planned work waits until you remember to lift it.

title: When should the hold on new lanes end?
